characters.summary: Diglett burrows underground to avoid attacks and strikes suddenly from below using physical attacks like Earthquake, Scratch, and Dig.

characters.summary: Ditto uses its unique Transform ability to copy the exact appearance, abilities, stats, and moves of any opposing Pokémon in battle.

Fails if the opponent has already transformed
mobility: Normal movement / Transforming to match opponents
limitations: Starts battle with only the Transform move until used.
